Container.Name: Shipmate
Container.Overview: A self-hosted crew of AI bots for everyday life and for work. One Captain coordinates, recruits and delegates to crew members you shape yourself; chat in the web app or on Discord, run scheduled Watches, and let the Shipyard work on GitHub projects in sandboxed containers. Several logins per instance with usage and cost tracked per person.[br][br]Needs a PostgreSQL database (for example the official postgres:17 image in its own container); see the Unraid README in the project for how to wire it.[br][br]Source-available under the PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 license: free for noncommercial use. It is not open source; commercial use needs a separate license.
Container.Requires: A PostgreSQL 15 or newer container (postgres:17 recommended) reachable from this container. Set DATABASE_URL to point at it.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the web app and API.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Crew, skills, workspaces, the generated encryption key (.secret) and backups (backups/).

Config.Name: Docker socket
Config.Description: Optional. Lets the Shipyard run code in per-project sandbox containers. Remove it to keep the Shipyard off. Anything with this socket controls Docker on the host.

Config.Name: DATABASE_URL
Config.Description: Postgres connection URL: postgres://user:password@host:port/database. Use the Unraid server's IP (or a custom Docker network and the Postgres container's name) and the port Postgres listens on.

Config.Name: SHIPMATE_URL
Config.Description: The address people open Shipmate at (used for links, webhooks and sign-in redirects). Use https://... behind a reverse proxy so cookies are marked Secure.

Config.Name: SHIPMATE_SECRET
Config.Description: Optional. Key that encrypts stored API keys and tokens. Leave empty to generate one on first start (kept in /data/.secret). If you set it, keep it forever: without it stored secrets cannot be read, even from a backup.

Config.Name: SHIPMATE_HOST_DATA_DIR
Config.Description: Optional. Host path of the Data folder above (e.g. /mnt/user/appdata/shipmate), used for sandbox bind mounts. Usually detected automatically.

Config.Name: SHIPMATE_BACKUP_DIR
Config.Description: Optional. Where backups are written inside the container (default /data/backups). Map another path (e.g. a share) to it to keep backups off the appdata disk.

Config.Name: SHIPMATE_SANDBOX_IMAGE
Config.Description: Optional. Default image for Shipyard sandboxes (e.g. node:22-bookworm).

Config.Name: SHIPMATE_MCP
Config.Description: on or off. off skips starting MCP servers for crew sessions (air-gapped installs).

Config.Name: LOG_LEVEL
Config.Description: Server log level: fatal, error, warn, info, debug, trace.
